source: The published index.js, index.d.ts, protected-api.js and protected-api.d.ts of 7.1.3.

omittedDependencies.@full-ui/headless-calendar: Peer dependency (7.1.3) that neither entry imports.
omittedDependencies.temporal-polyfill: Peer dependency (^1.0.1) that neither entry imports.

changes: Derived from @fullcalendar/core 7.1.3: the shared option interfaces FullCalendar 7 connectors extend, and the JSON feed request (requestJson, JsonRequestError, identity).
GET parameters are added to the query ahead of any #fragment, which fetch never sends, and without a dangling '?' or '&'.
Declarations type the response as the runtime's fetch Response, with a structural fallback, so they compile without DOM or Node types; FetchResponse is exported.
The entry exports nothing and no longer writes to the console on import; its declaration is a module.
The unused @full-ui/headless-calendar and temporal-polyfill peers are removed.
